Requirements emphasize throughput, bounded latency, auditability and KMS-backed key custody.

Reranker: prefer colocated cross-encoder to avoid network egress costs; evaluate distillation to cheaper model for tail queries.
Indexing: incremental reindexing cadence (daily diffs) + real-time small doc adds; need shard strategy to hit latency SLO at 1K qps.
Availability: enterprise SLA required (99.9) with automatic fallback to smaller hosted variant on node failure.
